plain: A person or bank that lets others borrow money

example.quote: We all know what has been the difficulty of procuring loans : we are sensible that foreign loans could not have been procured at all, had not the lenders been greatly interested in the success of the revolution.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 27, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
